The provided candidates for Goldman Sachs (gs_2024_7_D152 on attributed equity allocation and gs_2024_7_D006 on net revenue growth) focus on internal capital management and broad financial performance rather than retail digital banking user engagement or growth, making them substantively incomparable to Bank of America's disclosure.

comparisons.peer_summary: Active users are defined as those logging into web/mobile platforms within the past 90 days, with mobile-specific definitions also provided.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPMorgan Chase and Bank of America disclose metrics related to digital banking engagement, specifically defining and reporting on active users of web and mobile platforms. While BAC reports the growth in active mobile banking users (an increase of approximately two million), JPM provides the specific definition used to measure these active users, stating that users are those who have logged in within the past 90 days. BAC does not provide this specific frequency definition in the cited text, but both disclosures center on the same business driver: the adoption and active usage of digital banking channels by clients.

sentences.text: Active mobile banking users increased approximately two million, reflecting client growth and continuing changes in our clients' banking preferences.

(b)Users of all mobile platforms who have logged in within the past 90 days.
